name: Epoidesuchus
sum: Epoidesuchus is a long-jawed peirosaurid notosuchian from the Late Cretaceous Adamantina Formation of Brazil, described in 2024.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; the type specimen is held by a museum directed by Sandra Simionato Tavares.
biology: Long, gracile jaws like those of other pepesuchines, unlike peirosaurines, may indicate semi-aquatic habits like modern crocodilians.
author: Ruiz et al. 2024
